headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.0-modder.30
summary: Synced with upstream: library extraction now tracks per-library state with byte-size verification for faster, more reliable cache hits, and content management gained storage configuration improvements. We kept our lightweight WebSocket Discord RPC and the Minecraft background service instead of upstream's heavier Discord Social SDK, and fixed the language switcher after Android's locale-code normalization.

items.text: Upstream sync: reworked library extraction with a per-library remaining-set cache, legacy manifest migration and byte-size verification, plus content management and storage configuration improvements and an updated bundled libgxcore.so.
Language switcher now matches Android's normalized locale codes — Indonesian (id/in), Chinese and Turkish selections resolve to the right language again.

Launcher activity sharing stays on our lightweight WebSocket Discord RPC with the Minecraft background service — we skipped upstream's Discord Social SDK switch to avoid bundling the extra SDK into the APK.
